answer: Require every agent to lock a small refundable stake in a shared kernel contract before it can transact. The stake is a shale layer: cheap for one real agent, ruinous for a thousand fakes. New identities start with an ivory-list reputation of zero and earn trust only through attested work over time, so a Sybil swarm cannot buy history. If an identity is caught attesting fraudulently, its stake is slashed and its reputation reset, making each fake identity a sunk cost rather than a free vote.
